rows.name: SurfacesModuleConfig
rows.rationale: Headless Surface API type. Public extension surface for custom UI integrations.

rows.name: TextAddress
rows.rationale: Document API text target accepted by v2 comments, formatting, insertion, and replace-style operations; resolved and validated by the v2 Document API adapter.

rows.name: TextSegment
rows.rationale: Document API text-range segment used inside TextTarget.segments; needed for consumers typing multi-segment text targets from the root package.

rows.name: TextTarget
rows.rationale: Document API range target used by v2 comments, tracked-change decisions, fields, and selection flows; resolved by the v2 Document API adapter.

rows.name: ToolbarCustomButton
rows.rationale: Canonical union of the ui.toolbar.customButtons entry shapes. Public extension surface, and the name a consumer annotates with when assembling entries outside the config object.

rows.name: ToolbarCustomButtonContext
rows.rationale: Context passed to a custom toolbar command, including the selected dropdown row on 'option'.

rows.name: ToolbarCustomButtonItem
rows.rationale: Button member of the ToolbarCustomButton union. Requires 'icon': 'defaultLabel' satisfies the affordance check and then renders nothing.

rows.name: ToolbarCustomDropdownItem
rows.rationale: Dropdown member of the ToolbarCustomButton union. Requires a visible trigger, which is 'icon', 'label', or 'hasCaret'.

rows.name: ToolbarCustomDropdownOption
rows.rationale: Row shape for a custom dropdown. Carries the member 'dropdownValueKey' names and the key that reaches the command.

rows.name: ToolbarCustomSeparatorItem
rows.rationale: Separator member of the ToolbarCustomButton union. Renders on its own and has nothing to run, so it carries no command.

rows.name: TrackChangeAuthor
rows.rationale: Structured author identity passed to modules.trackChanges.authorColors.resolve.

rows.name: TrackChangeHighlightColors
rows.rationale: Tracked-change highlight color shape, referenced by CommentsConfig for both the base and active states.

rows.name: TrackChangesAuthorColorsConfig
rows.rationale: Module config for per-author tracked-change colors (modules.trackChanges.authorColors). Documented at the module-config layer.

rows.name: TrackChangesModuleConfig
rows.rationale: Module config for track-changes (modules.trackChanges). Documented at the module-config layer.

rows.name: TrackChangesSemanticColorsConfig
rows.rationale: Module config for semantic tracked-change colors (modules.trackChanges.semanticColors). Documented at the module-config layer.

rows.name: TrackedChangeAddress
rows.rationale: Document API navigation/address/selection type. Promoted into the root facade by SD-3185.

rows.name: TrackedChangeSemanticColorKey
rows.rationale: Semantic key union used by modules.trackChanges.semanticColors overrides and resolver input. Named so consumers can type supported tracked-change color keys.

rows.name: TrackedChangeSemanticColorResolverInput
rows.rationale: Resolver input passed to modules.trackChanges.semanticColors.resolve. Named so consumers can type semantic color resolver callbacks.

rows.name: UIConfig
rows.rationale: Built-in UI configuration type for Config.ui. Customer-facing: names which built-in surfaces SuperDoc renders.

rows.name: UpgradeToCollaborationOptions
rows.rationale: Customer-facing core API type or runtime export. Type-reachable through documented config / callback / event / method surfaces; runtime exports are documented utilities.

rows.name: User
rows.rationale: Customer-facing user identity type used by v2 config, collaboration/awareness, shared-user management, and locking methods.

rows.name: V2CollaborationConfig
rows.rationale: Configuration type for SuperDoc v2's document-level single-doc y-websocket collaboration handoff.

rows.name: ViewOptions
rows.rationale: Customer-facing view configuration type; Config.viewOptions.layout drives v2 print/web layout behavior.

rows.name: ViewingVisibilityConfig
rows.rationale: Customer-facing core API type or runtime export. Type-reachable through documented config / callback / event / method surfaces; runtime exports are documented utilities.

rows.name: buildTheme
rows.rationale: Customer-facing core API type or runtime export. Type-reachable through documented config / callback / event / method surfaces; runtime exports are documented utilities.

rows.name: compareVersions
rows.rationale: Customer-facing core API type or runtime export. Type-reachable through documented config / callback / event / method surfaces; runtime exports are documented utilities.

rows.name: createTheme
rows.rationale: Customer-facing core API type or runtime export. Type-reachable through documented config / callback / event / method surfaces; runtime exports are documented utilities.

rows.name: defineSuperDocExtension
rows.rationale: v2 SuperDoc extension factory/validation helper. Documented runtime export used to author extensions passed to Config.extensions.

rows.name: getFileObject
rows.rationale: Customer-facing core API type or runtime export. Type-reachable through documented config / callback / event / method surfaces; runtime exports are documented utilities.
